name: Branch to Branch
description: Grants a +10 competence bonus on Climb checks in trees. While at least 10 ft. above the ground in medium or dense forest, the caster can brachiate through the canopy, gaining a +10-ft. enhancement bonus to land speed and ignoring undergrowth movement penalties (charging is allowed, running is not) until forest cover breaks.

name: Hawkeye
description: Sharpens the caster's long-range vision: ranged weapon range increments increase by 50%, and a +5 competence bonus applies to Spot checks, for the duration.

name: Healthful Rest

targetAreaEffect.value: One creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 feet apart

description: Doubles the subjects' natural healing rate: each affected creature regains twice the hit points it would otherwise recover that day, based on its activity level.

name: Vine Strike
description: For 1 round, lets the caster deliver sneak attack damage to plant creatures (normally immune to it), provided the normal conditions for a sneak attack are otherwise met. Affects only sneak attack damage — it grants no way to score critical hits against plants or bypass their other defenses.

name: Balancing Lorecall
description: Grants a +4 insight bonus on Balance checks. With 5+ ranks in Balance, the caster can balance on an otherwise impossible surface (DC 20) and move on vertical surfaces without losing her Dexterity bonus to AC or her ability to attack normally. With 10+ ranks, this extends to liquids and similarly unstable surfaces, though the DC rises by 5 for each consecutive round balanced there. Arcane material component: a small wooden dowel.

name: Daggerspell Stance
description: Requires wielding two daggers to take effect (though it doesn't end if a dagger is dropped, thrown, or lost). On a full attack while holding a dagger in each hand, grants a +2 insight bonus on attack and damage rolls made with daggers that round. While fighting defensively with two daggers, grants spell resistance equal to 5 + caster level; while using the total defense action with two daggers, grants that same spell resistance plus DR 5/magic. Focus: a pair of daggers.

name: Easy Trail
description: Radiates an aura that gently parts vegetation for anyone in the area (including the caster), removing the usual movement penalty for undergrowth and raising the DC to track anyone who passed through by 5. Has no effect on plant creatures, and the trail-hiding lapses once the spell ends.

name: Embrace the Wild
description: Lets the caster adopt the natural and extraordinary senses (blindsense, blindsight, darkvision, low-light vision, scent, as applicable) of any animal with Hit Dice up to her caster level, without changing shape, and optionally swap either or both of her own Listen/Spot modifiers for that animal's.

name: Healing Lorecall
description: With 5+ ranks in Heal, lets a conjuration (healing) spell also remove dazed, dazzled, or fatigued from its target (10+ ranks adds exhausted, nauseated, or sickened); also lets the caster substitute her Heal ranks for caster level when determining how much a conjuration (healing) spell cures (normal per-spell caster-level caps still apply). Material component: a small mint leaf.

name: Listening Lorecall
description: Grants a +4 insight bonus on Listen checks. 5+ ranks in Listen adds blindsense out to 30 ft.; 10+ ranks upgrades that to blindsight out to 30 ft. instead. A silence effect negates the granted blindsense/blindsight.

name: Nature's Favor
description: Touch grants an animal a +1 luck bonus on attack and damage rolls per three caster levels, to a maximum of +5 at 15th level.

name: Train Animal
description: A 10-minute casting that temporarily grants a touched animal additional known tricks equal to half the caster's level (maximum five) for the duration; it doesn't change the animal's attitude toward the caster or guarantee it will actually perform the newly learned tricks.

name: Wracking Touch
description: A touch attack dealing 1d6 damage plus 1 point per caster level (maximum +10). If the caster has the sneak attack ability, the touch also deals sneak attack damage — without needing the target flanked or denied its Dexterity bonus — unless the target is immune to extra damage from critical hits; the base spell damage still applies either way.

name: Entangling Staff
savingThrow: Yes (harmless, object) [as printed; wording is unusual for a Saving Throw entry and may reflect an OCR misread of the source]
description: Causes a wielded quarterstaff to sprout vines. A successful melee strike with the staff deals normal damage and lets the caster attempt a free grapple check (no separate touch attack, no attack of opportunity) with a +8 bonus, against foes up to one size category larger. A successful grapple lets the vines constrict for 2d6 damage (lethal or nonlethal, caster's choice); the caster can then release the hold (leaving the foe entangled for the duration) or maintain it for repeated constriction damage each round. Focus: a quarterstaff.

name: Fly, Swift
description: A swift-action version of fly: grants a fly speed of 60 ft. with average maneuverability for 1 round, otherwise following the base fly spell's rules.

name: Forestfold
description: Attunes the caster's coloring and footfalls to one chosen terrain type (aquatic, desert, plains, forest, hills, mountains, marsh, or underground), granting a +20 competence bonus on Hide and Move Silently checks while there. The bonus persists even through a brief departure from and return to that terrain within the spell's duration.

name: Cloak of the Sea
description: The subject takes on a blue-green watery appearance. While underwater, it gains the effects of blur, freedom of movement, and water breathing, plus immunity to nonlethal damage from water pressure or hypothermia. Leaving the water (even partially) suspends all these benefits except water breathing; moving between water and air doesn't end the spell early.
